




```{r}
# Flowchart
library(DiagrammeR)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(rsvg)

flowchart <- grViz("
digraph flowchart {

  graph [layout = dot,
         rankdir = TB,
         label = 'Figure S1.Flowchart of Study Population and Analysis Pipeline\\nFramingham Heart Study',
         labelloc = t,
         fontsize = 20,
         fontname = Helvetica]

  node [shape = box,
        style = 'rounded,filled',
        fontname = Helvetica,
        fontsize = 13,
        color = '#1B3A4B',
        fillcolor = '#EEF3F6',
        penwidth = 1.2]

  edge [color = '#1B3A4B',
        penwidth = 1.1,
        arrowsize = 0.8]

  # Main nodes
  A [label = 'Framingham Heart Study longitudinal dataset\\nPeriod 1: n = 4,434\\nPeriod 2: n = 3,930\\nPeriod 3: n = 3,263']

  B [label = 'Primary analysis restricted to baseline (Period 1)\\nBaseline sample: n = 4,434']

  X1 [label = 'Excluded at baseline:\\nPrevalent stroke (PREVSTRK = 1)\\n(n = 32)',
      fillcolor = '#F4F6F7',
      color = '#7B8A8B']

  C [label = 'Final baseline analytic sample\\nFree of stroke at baseline\\nn = 4,402']

  D [label = 'Sex-stratified analytic sample\\nMen: n = 1,930\\nWomen: n = 2,472']

  E [label = 'Create 10-year outcome variables\\nFollow-up truncated at 10 years (3,650 days)\\nIncident stroke within 10 years']

  F [label = 'Baseline characteristics by sex']

  X2 [label = 'Excluded for complete-case analysis:\\nMen removed: n = 33\\nWomen removed: n = 94',
      fillcolor = '#F4F6F7',
      color = '#7B8A8B']

  G [label = 'Complete-case sample for Kaplan-Meier curves\\nand log-rank test\\nMen: n = 1,897\\nWomen: n = 2,378']

  H [label = 'Sex-specific Cox proportional hazards models\\nCandidate variables: age, systolic BP, diabetes, \\nBP medication, cholesterol, BMI, prevalent CHD\\nBackward selection with age, systolic BP,\\nand diabetes forced into all models']

  I [label = 'Predicted 10-year stroke risk\\nIllustrative profiles by sex\\nAges 40, 50, and 60\\nProfiles: high BP only, diabetes only,\\nhigh BP + diabetes, current smoker only']

  J [label = 'Descriptive longitudinal assessment\\nRisk factor changes across Periods 1-3\\nBlood pressure and diabetes prevalence']

  # Main flow
  A -> B
  B -> C
  C -> D -> E -> F -> G -> H -> I
  A -> J

  # Exclusion branches
  B -> X1
  F -> X2

  # Layout hints
  {rank=same; B X1}
  {rank=same; F X2}
}
")

flowchart
```



```{r}
svg_txt <- export_svg(flowchart)  # returns SVG text
rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_txt),
         file = "Project3_Flowchart.png",
         width = 3000, height = 4000)  # high-res
```
